item.text: I’ve verified the Node port on the main cases locally. I’m cleaning up the parallel probe agent now and then I’ll give you the generated file set and what was validated.

item.command:
/bin/bash -c "cases=(
  \"--help\"
  \"\"
  \"--a '{}' --b string\"
  \"--a '{}' --b number\"
  \"--a '{}' --b foo\"
  \"--a '{' --b string\"
  \"--a 'null' --b string\"
  \"--a '[]' --b string\"
  \"--a '{\\\""'$id'"\\\":1}' --b string\"
  \"--he\"
  \"--help=1\"
  \"--a --b string\"
  \"--a=-1 --b string\"
  \"--a '{}' --b -1\"
)
for args in \""'${cases[@]}"; do
  set +e
  py_text=$(eval "/workspace/dataset/test8_executable $args" 2>&1)
  py_code=$?
  js_text=$(eval "node /output/test8.mjs $args" 2>&1)
  js_code=$?
  set -e
  py_sanitized=$(printf "%s" "$py_text" | sed "s/test8_executable/test8.mjs/g; /'"\\[PYI-[0-9][0-9]*:ERROR\\] Failed to execute script 'test8' due to unhandled exception"'!/d")
  if [ "$py_code" -ne "$js_code" ] || [ "$py_sanitized" != "$js_text" ]; then
    printf "Mismatch for args: %s'"\\npy_code=%s js_code=%s\\n\" \""'$args" "$py_code" "$js_code"
  fi
done'
